hooks.command: i=$(cat); if [ -z "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] || [ ! -d "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.git" ]; then echo "SDLC skill ledger did NOT record this activation: CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is unset or is not the repo root." >&2; exit 2; fi; printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$i" >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.git/sdlc-skill-ledger.jsonl"
